sources.use: 매입형 금속 함의 접힌 문 가장자리·프레임·캠 잠금쇠

outputs.prompt: Create one photorealistic modeling reference sheet for a small closed flush-mounted electrical enclosure in the corridor of an ordinary Korean villa. Input 1 is a real manufacturer's recessed steel enclosure photograph: reference its folded steel door edge, narrow frame and low-profile cylindrical cam lock. Input 2 is our matching branch-panel study: keep the same restrained gray powder-coat, thin seam, modest wear, and hinge proportions. Show the same CLOSED cabinet in front, three-quarter, and side views, plus a macro of the shallow lock. Rectangular face 34 cm wide, 50 cm tall; most of the 6cm case recesses into a plain plaster wall, leaving an approximately 8mm rim. Door stays closed, plain blank face, two small hinges at the left edge, low-profile round slotted latch on the right. Neutral soft light, realistic painted steel without heavy grime. Small blank adhesive title strip above center; all actual Korean lettering is made separately. No logos, no words, no fake letters, no hazard graphic, no rust streaks, no wires, no key hanging out, no exposed breakers, no dramatic horror decoration. Views must agree dimensionally. This is reference photography for modeling, not a game screenshot.

note: 실물 사진과 같은 날 만든 로비 분전반 시트를 함께 참고했다. 생성한 벽은 모델링 참고용이며 게임 벽에는 기존 스터코 재질을 쓴다.
